baseline_models.focus_anchor: The construction يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ joins a forceful outward verb directly to truth.
baseline_models.mechanism: Casting gives truth trajectory and impact, while the reality-stability and manifestation branches of ح ق ق constrain that force as disclosure rather than random aggression.

activation_trace.role: Throwing or projecting at distance supplies the forceful outward trajectory of the focus action.
Stable correspondence with reality identifies the cast as truth-bearing rather than arbitrary force.
Establishing and making truth evident supplies the cast's revelatory effect.

changed_reading.before: My Lord states or presents the truth.
changed_reading.after: My Lord forcefully projects reality-grounded truth into a field where it becomes manifest.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْ opens a public utterance, while عَلَّامُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ closes the ayah with exhaustive knowledge of what is hidden.
baseline_models.mechanism: The command to externalize speech and the epithet of hidden knowledge occupy opposite ends of a transmission path; يَقْذِفُ is the crossing that carries hidden knowledge into audible truth.

activation_trace.role: Producing speech by articulation supplies the public endpoint of the mechanism.
Projection carries material from its source toward an exposed receiving field.
Knowledge as disclosure to the knower supplies the fully informed source.
What is screened from eyes and human knowledge supplies the concealed domain crossed by the message.

changed_reading.before: The speaker is ordered to report that God knows the unseen.
changed_reading.after: The commanded utterance is the public terminus of truth projected from a source whose knowledge reaches beyond observers.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قُلْ and the الكلام branch of ق ذ ف make the focus action simultaneously speech-shaped and forceful.
baseline_models.mechanism: The speech/accusation branch of ق ذ ف turns the cast into a verbal intervention, while the tightly verified speech branch of ح ق ق distinguishes it from slander.

activation_trace.role: Articulated saying provides the verbal carrier.
Casting words, blame, or accusation supplies the contested-speech domain and the force of a countercharge.
Tightly wrought and verified speech makes the verbal cast coherent and sound.

changed_reading.before: The ayah is a neutral proclamation about truth.
changed_reading.after: The commanded saying delivers a true verbal countercharge into a field of rival claims.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The acting subject is specifically رَبِّى, not an unqualified agent of force.
baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord's repairing, nurturing, and completing relation governs the force of ق ذ ف; the cast can therefore function as a corrective intervention that completes matters by manifesting truth.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion frame the agent's force as governed correction.
The throw supplies the decisive intervention into an existing condition.
Establishing and displaying truth supplies the corrective result.

changed_reading.before: Casting suggests force without specifying its governance.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's cast is disciplined correction: it repairs a distorted field by establishing what is true.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَقْذِفُ supplies trajectory, while حق and علام carry branches of straight penetration and distinguishing marks.
baseline_models.mechanism: A projected object that penetrates without deviation combines with knowledge as a guiding mark, producing a model of truth that reaches and identifies its proper locus rather than merely filling space.

activation_trace.role: Projection supplies a directed path toward a target.
A straight thrust that penetrates supplies non-deviating entry into the target.
A distinguishing sign that guides supplies identification of the reached locus.

changed_reading.before: Truth is dispatched forcefully in a general direction.
changed_reading.after: Truth is projected as a penetrating mark that reaches, exposes, and identifies its proper locus.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first maps divine knowledge across ingress, emergence, descent, and ascent, then identifies what descends from the Lord as truth that guides. The focus cast becomes a directed delivery within that larger circulation.

activation_trace.role: Projection provides the focus action whose direction is sharpened by the contextual motion system.
Entry into an interior supplies one leg of the world-crossing circulation known by the Lord.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies a transition from hidden interior to exposure.
Sending down and delivering supplies a downward transfer rather than an undirected throw.
Ascent completes the paired vertical circulation over which divine knowledge ranges.
Delivered descent identifies the revelation's route from the Lord to the addressee.
Reality-corresponding truth explicitly identifies the descending content.
Gentle direction toward the true path supplies the delivered truth's recipient-facing effect.

structural_cues: 34:2 arranges four directional verbs around comprehensive divine knowledge.
34:6 makes descent from the Lord, truth, and guidance one sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: ingress, emergence, descent, ascent, and revelation-as-truth are supplied. Reader arrow: the focus cast is treated as another directed transfer from hidden source to worldly recipient. Live alternative: ق ذ ف may foreground impact rather than vertical descent.

changed_reading.before: The truth is thrown outward like an isolated projectile.
changed_reading.after: Truth is delivered from the Lord into the visible world as the descending, guiding leg of a fully known circulation.

context_deltas.mechanism: A hidden creeping process consumes a support until a noisy fall makes the jinn's ignorance of the unseen evident. This revises the focus cast from speech alone into a broader disclosure event in which a material change can project truth into visibility.

activation_trace.role: Forceful projection anchors the contextual fall-and-disclosure sequence back in the focus action.
Hidden creeping supplies the initially imperceptible causal process.
Consumption as corrosion supplies the gradual removal of the visible support.
A turbulent, sounding fall supplies the sudden public event that replaces concealment.
Appearance and uncovering provide the event's epistemic result.
Knowledge opposed to ignorance states what the material disclosure tests.
The domain hidden from observers is exactly what the exposed ignorance fails to reach.

structural_cues: 34:14 delays disclosure through a hidden process, then pivots at the fall to تَبَيَّنَتِ.
The resulting disclosure specifically concerns whether the jinn knew the unseen.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: hidden creeping, consumption, collapse, disclosure, and failed unseen-knowledge are supplied. Reader arrow: the fall is treated as a material analogue of truth being cast into view. Live alternative: the episode may illustrate علم/غيب without specifying the mechanics of ق ذ ف.

changed_reading.before: Casting truth means sending a verbal proposition.
changed_reading.after: Casting truth can culminate in an event that materially collapses a false appearance and exposes previously hidden reality.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet places a conjecture beside apparent confirmation and then distinguishes belief from unresolved doubt. The focus pairing of truth with the Knower of unseen therefore carries a provenance test: a claim's successful appearance is not equivalent to knowledge-grounded truth.

activation_trace.role: Verbal casting supplies the general class of forceful claims whose epistemic sources can differ.
Correspondence with stable reality supplies the focus criterion beyond persuasive appearance.
Knowledge supplies the warranted source attached to the focus truth.
Truthfulness of a saying supplies the apparent confirmation side of the contrast.
Conjecture and supposition preserve the claim's uncertain epistemic origin despite its confirmation.
Interpenetrating alternatives without settled certainty supply the unresolved state opposed to warranted knowledge.

structural_cues: 34:21 frames the separation of belief and doubt as something known under the Lord's preservation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: confirmation, conjecture, and unsettled doubt are supplied. Reader arrow: their juxtaposition makes source-quality, not outcome alone, part of بِٱلْحَقِّ. Live alternative: صَدَّقَ may denote fulfillment without granting any epistemic credit to the conjecture.

changed_reading.before: Truth is whatever claim is borne out.
changed_reading.after: The focus truth is warranted by the Knower of the unseen; it is categorically different from a conjecture that merely appears fulfilled.

context_deltas.mechanism: Once fear is cleared, the Lord's speech is answered as truth; elsewhere the Lord gathers opposed parties and opens what is closed between them by truth. The focus cast thus acts as an authoritative intervention that resolves a contested field.

activation_trace.role: A forceful verbal charge anchors the model in contested speech.
Removal of fear clears the affective obstruction before the Lord's saying is identified.
Repeated articulated saying stages reception, question, and answer around the divine utterance.
The answer 'truth' identifies the stable content of what the Lord said.
Gathering separated parties creates the shared field in which resolution occurs.
Opening a closure by judgment supplies the adjudicative operation performed between the parties.
Establishing and displaying truth supplies the criterion and result of judgment.

structural_cues: 34:23 asks what the Lord said and answers ٱلْحَقَّ.
34:26 repeats بَيْنَنَا around gathering and opening بِٱلْحَقِّ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: cleared fear, divine saying, gathered parties, and opening-by-truth are supplied. Reader arrow: the focus cast is assigned the function of breaking a dispute's closure and establishing judgment. Live alternative: these passages may describe related divine acts without making adjudication intrinsic to يَقْذِفُ.

changed_reading.before: Truth is projected as information or rebuttal.
changed_reading.after: Truth is cast as a verdict-like intervention that opens a closed dispute and separates valid from invalid claims.

context_deltas.mechanism: Truth arrives and is first relabeled as deceptive magic; after the focus cast, truth's arrival is stated again while falsehood can neither initiate nor return. The cast reads as an intervention that disables falsehood's productive and recurrent cycle.

activation_trace.role: Forceful projection supplies the intervening event between contested reception and falsehood's failure.
Making truth manifest supplies the cast's positive operation.
Arrival makes truth an event encountered by opponents rather than a static abstraction.
Diversion and deception supply the opponents' attempted relabeling of the arriving truth.
Renewed arrival immediately after the focus confirms the cast as an accomplished ingress.
The paired beginning-and-return branch supplies the two ends of falsehood's blocked cycle.
Loss of truth and stability identifies the rival process that cannot sustain itself.
Return after departure supplies recurrence, explicitly denied to falsehood.

structural_cues: 34:43 and 34:49 both stage truth as something that comes.
34:49 immediately follows the focus and negates both beginning and return for falsehood.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: truth's arrival, its hostile relabeling, and falsehood's inability to begin or return are supplied. Reader arrow: the focus cast is treated as the interruption that causes this loss of generative capacity. Live alternative: 34:49 may announce the result without assigning a causal mechanism to ق ذ ف.

changed_reading.before: The Lord launches one successful truth statement.
changed_reading.after: The Lord's cast installs truth as an event that survives hostile relabeling and breaks falsehood's ability to originate or recur.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby command to say delivers a fear-softening reminder, asks hearers to rise to the matter, and then sends the heart repeatedly through it. The cast's force is therefore compatible with a deliberative reception process rather than coercive implantation.

activation_trace.role: Articulated speech anchors the contextual exhortation as a mode of delivery.
Projection supplies the forceful stimulus whose reception is clarified by the preceding instruction.
A fear-bearing reminder that softens the heart supplies the speech's affective entry.
Resolute rising toward a matter supplies the hearer's active response.
Repeated movement of the heart through the matter supplies reflective processing after reception.

structural_cues: 34:46 sequences قُلْ, exhortation, standing in pairs or singly, and reflection.
The focus repeats قُلْ two ayat later, linking the cast to the same address situation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: exhortation, rising, and reflection are supplied as the nearby response protocol. Reader arrow: they are treated as how the cast enters and works on hearers. Live alternative: 34:46 may prescribe independent inquiry without defining the semantic force of ق ذ ف.

changed_reading.before: A forceful cast overwhelms passive recipients.
changed_reading.after: The cast is a forceful summons that becomes effective through softened attention, active standing, and reflective reconsideration.

context_deltas.mechanism: The speaker's guidance is tied to what his Lord reveals, and the branch inventory describes revelation as knowledge cast in concealment and divine news. This supplies the missing interface between the Knower of unseen and the commanded public saying.

activation_trace.role: Public articulation supplies the outward endpoint of revelation.
Projection supplies the transfer from concealed source to public field.
Concealment from human sight supplies the source-side domain of the transfer.
Guidance toward truth supplies the effect attributed to what is revealed.
Casting knowledge in concealment supplies an unusually close lexical mechanism for the inward transfer.
Divine news and inspiration identify the transfer's source and content.
Nearness opposes the remote speculation later attached to false casting.

structural_cues: 34:50 again begins قُلْ and attributes guidance to what the speaker's Lord reveals to him.
The same ayah closes with divine hearing and nearness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: guidance, concealed impartation, divine news, and nearness are supplied. Reader arrow: revelation is the inward phase that becomes the outward cast through قُلْ. Live alternative: ق ذ ف may name the public impact of revelation without naming its private transmission mode.

changed_reading.before: The Knower of unseen directly casts truth into the world.
changed_reading.after: Concealed divine impartation reaches the messenger as guidance and is then projected outward through commanded speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close forms a controlled reversal: the Lord casts with truth while knowing the unseen, but deniers cast verbally at the unseen from a distant place. Near seizure and failed distant reaching turn source position, epistemic warrant, and object of casting into a single contrast.

activation_trace.role: The Lord's projected cast supplies the first side of the closing reversal.
Stable reality is the medium or payload that warrants the first cast.
Full knowledge supplies the source competence behind the first cast.
Nearness supplies effective reach and contrasts with the deniers' distant position.
Reaching by extending toward something supplies the grasp that distance now makes impossible.
Distance from nearness supplies the failed epistemic and practical position.
Casting words or accusations supplies the deniers' unwarranted counter-cast.
What is hidden from human sight is their target rather than a domain they know.
The uncertainty branch sharpens their speech as speculation rather than knowledge-grounded disclosure.
Explicit remoteness completes the spatial and epistemic contrast with the knowing source.

structural_cues: 34:48 يَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ is answered in 34:53 by يَقْذِفُونَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ.
34:48 places knowledge before الغيوب, whereas 34:53 places deniers at a distant location from الغيب.
34:51-52 oppose effective nearness to an impossible attempt to reach from afar.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the repeated ق ذ ف construction, exchanged objects حق/غيب, knowing/denying agents, and near/far reach are supplied. Reader arrow: these are read as a deliberate epistemic reversal that defines valid casting by provenance and position. Live alternative: 34:53 may condemn a broader pattern of remote speculation without functioning as a direct gloss of 34:48.

changed_reading.before: عَلَّامُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ is an appended honorific and يَقْذِفُ is a generic image of force.
changed_reading.after: The epithet is the warrant that separates a truth-bearing cast from remote speech hurled toward what its speakers cannot know.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping for قُلْ. It remains anchored in the supplied focus inventory and converges with the motion of يَقْذِفُ, but downstream prose should present it only as form-distant activation, not as the lexical meaning of the imperative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The packet maps focus قُلْ both to ق و ل and, non-dominantly, to ق ل ل branches of carrying, rising, setting out, and instability of motion.

activation_trace.role: Carrying, rising, and setting out recast the imperative as mobilizing the message.
Agitation and movement reinforce speech leaving a fixed position.
Rapid propulsion turns the mobilized saying into a swiftly dispatched truth-message.

changed_reading.before: قُلْ is only a quotation command.
changed_reading.after: At a form-distant exploratory level, قُلْ also cues lifting, carrying, and setting the truth-message into motion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain model is surprising because it joins truthful speech to the surah's armor-making instructions. It remains anchored in حق's tightly woven speech branch and ق ذ ف's projected force, with exact contextual links of coverage, measure, and connected rings; render it as a material analogy for coherent discourse, never as literal armor or a claim that 34:11 directly interprets 34:48.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: حق carries a branch of tightly woven cloth or speech, adjacent in the focus to articulated saying and projection.

activation_trace.role: Tightly woven cloth or well-formed speech supplies the bridge from verbal truth to linked material construction.
Articulation keeps the material analogy attached to actual utterance.
Projection gives the coherent utterance outward force.
Extended coverage supplies the protective completeness of the linked construction.
Fitting each element to its proper measure supplies calibration rather than indiscriminate force.
Successive connected elements supply discourse whose claims reinforce one another.
Piercing and linking rings supplies the striking image of individually forceful units joined into a coherent whole.

changed_reading.before: The Lord casts a single isolated truth-projectile.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the cast can be a calibrated chain of interlocking true utterances whose coherence both advances and protects.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because it combines projectile trajectory with particle-scale accounting. It remains anchored in يَقْذِفُ and عَلَّام and is activated by the packet's explicit claim that no particle-weight escapes knowledge; downstream prose should call it a precision analogy, not import modern weapon imagery.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines directed projection with an intensive knower, allowing contextual resolution-scale to modify the cast.

activation_trace.role: Projection supplies the trajectory whose precision is being tested.
Comprehensive knowing supplies the targeting intelligence in the analogy.
Absence, distance, or escape is explicitly negated, leaving no blind region.
Exact weight supplies a scale of discriminating measure.
Minute particles and their dispersal supply the smallest stated resolution of that knowledge.
Recorded establishment supplies complete registration rather than approximate awareness.

changed_reading.before: Force is the main feature of the cast.
changed_reading.after: The cast is also exact: it proceeds from knowledge in which no dispersed particle is absent or unregistered.

strongest_changes: The 34:48/34:53 reversal turns عَلَّامُ ٱلْغُيُوبِ into the epistemic warrant separating truth-bearing projection from remote speculation.
Descent, guidance, and concealed revelation make the cast a transfer from hidden divine knowledge through the messenger into public speech.
Truth's arrival after the focus disables falsehood's capacity to begin or return, giving the cast a cycle-breaking function.
The judgment and collapse sequences allow truth to appear as adjudicative and material disclosure, not only as a proposition.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly converted one compact clause into a controlled transfer across hidden and manifest, near and far, speech and event, and warranted knowledge and conjecture. Split-root and material branches preserved motion, coherence, and precision as contained exploratory readings.
remaining_uncertainties: بِٱلْحَقِّ can leave truth as instrument, manner, or payload, and the packet does not force one relation.
The material-collapse, chainmail, and precision models may be resonant analogies rather than intrinsic mechanics of ق ذ ف.
The closing parallel strongly supports deliberate reversal, but 34:53 can still condemn remote speculation more broadly rather than narrowly glossing 34:48.
